fields.description: Master switch for the LLM assistant. Until this is on with a provider below, the chat answers from its deterministic rules only.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1 · Ollama on this host: http://host.containers.internal:11434/v1 · Azure: your deployment gateway · Custom: any OpenAI-compatible /v1
fields.label: API Base URL

fields.description: Per user, per hour. Counted in Redis.
fields.label: Rate Limit / hour

fields.description: Lets the assistant find customers, items, employees, leads, tickets and so on, as the requesting user.
fields.label: Allow Record Lookup

fields.description: Lets the assistant tell the user which Desk page to open.
fields.label: Allow Navigation Hints

fields.description: Reserved for ticket status transitions. Off by default: changing a ticket's state should be a human decision.
fields.label: Allow Status Update

fields.description: Master switch for the transactional chat entry flow (Desk and Portal).
fields.label: Enable Universal Chat

fields.description: Off by default: the chat resolves intents deterministically until you turn this on.
fields.label: Enable LLM Fallback

fields.description: Destructive actions stay off unless there is a review process.
fields.label: Allow Delete

fields.description: Workflow transitions from chat require this and a confirmation turn.
fields.label: Allow Approve

fields.description: Clarification loop guard: how many field questions one turn may ask.
fields.label: Max Slot Turns

fields.description: Respect field-level security: permlevel > 0 fields are never read or written from chat.
fields.label: Enforce Permlevel

fields.description: One DocType per line. Empty means the built-in registry. Even a role that could write a DocType cannot touch it from chat unless it is listed here.
fields.label: Allowed DocTypes

fields.description: One DocType per line. Empty means every active workflow may be actioned (with chat_allow_approve on).
fields.label: Allowed Workflows

fields.description: Comma separated. DocTypes the My Tasks quick action searches.
fields.label: My Tasks DocTypes

fields.description: Field urgency sets on create/update. Empty records urgency in the audit log only. Urgency never widens permissions.
fields.label: Urgency Field

fields.description: Audit rows are the record of what the assistant was allowed to do; treat this as a data-protection control.
fields.label: Audit Log Retention (days)
